name: Progress
description: Shows how far along a task is, as a bar or a ring.

value.description: Current progress value (0-100). Null for indeterminate.

label.description: Label text above the progress bar

formatValue.description: Custom formatter for displayed progress value

when: How much of a form is filled in
Waits where you know the duration
whenNot: You cannot say how long — use Loading
Status with no number — use Badge
guidelines: Pass a value when you know the percentage; pass null when you do not
Add a label whenever the bar alone leaves the purpose unclear
success, warning, and danger carry state, not decoration
variant="neutral" with role="meter" for a magnitude where full is not success
Values outside min and max are clamped before display
accessibility: role="meter" is accepted for scalar readings inside a known range
The label is tied to the bar
Value changes are announced as they happen

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Determinate bar with its percentage spelled out.

examples.name: Variants
examples.description: Colour carries state: normal, done, tight, critical.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="md">
  <Progress value={75} variant="default" label="Processing" showValue />
  <Progress value={100} variant="success" label="Complete" showValue />
  <Progress value={80} variant="warning" label="Almost full" showValue />
  <Progress value={95} variant="danger" label="Storage critical" showValue />
</Stack>

examples.name: Meter
examples.description: A reading where hitting the top is not a win.
examples.code:
<Progress
  value={42}
  variant="neutral"
  role="meter"
  label="Seats used"
  showValue
/>

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: Thin for table rows, thick when the bar is the point.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="md">
  <Progress value={50} size="sm" label="Small" />
  <Progress value={50} size="md" label="Medium" />
  <Progress value={50} size="lg" label="Large" />
</Stack>

examples.name: Circular
examples.description: Same value in a ring, for tiles and compact chrome.
examples.code:
import { CircularProgress } from '@/components/Progress';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="lg" align="center">
  <CircularProgress value={25} size="sm" />
  <CircularProgress value={50} size="md" showValue />
  <CircularProgress value={75} size="lg" showValue variant="success" />
  <CircularProgress value={null} size="md" />
</Stack>

relations.note: Use Badge for status without percentage

propsSummary: value: number|null - progress percentage (null for indeterminate)
Determinate display values are clamped (and invalid min/max ranges render as 0%)
